description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'ClusterUtil' providing static methods to manage Akka cluster singleton actors, including starting singleton proxies and singleton actors with configurable settings and supervision strategies.

classes.name: ClusterUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate management of Akka cluster singleton actors, including starting proxies and singleton actors with optional supervision strategies.

methods.name: startSingletonProxy
methods.description: Creates and starts a singleton proxy actor within the provided actor context, targeting the specified singleton actor and role.

methods.name: startSingleton
